title: Prorating of inside and outdoor air.
officialText:
In spaces that utilize a combination of inside and outdoor air, the sum of the ratios of
all direct openings, horizontal openings, vertical openings and interior spaces shall equal or exceed 1.
SECTION MC 705
COMBINED USE OF INSIDE AND OUTDOOR AIR
(CONDITION 2)
